Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection in Houston, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling
through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2 entered from a cross street and struck the driver's side of
Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and was present at the
scene, as confirmed by both drivers and two independent witnesses. Passenger reported a concussion and
complained of head pain and dizziness; the nature of the impact and the way the occupant's body moved inside the
vehicle are consistent with that complaint. Witnesses, scene photographs and Driver 2's own statement all agree on
the sequence of events as described by Driver 1. The damage to Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with a
broadside impact of this type. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy. No prior damage to the vehicle is
known to officers or to Driver 1. Both drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles were removed from the roadway by
tow operators.
